Mark Zuckerberg Skips Coffee for Jiu-Jitsu
In 2025, speaking with comedian
Theo Von
, the Meta CEO said he does not regularly drink coffee and generally avoids anything that alters his normal state.
"I just like hate anything that messes with like—I don’t like any kind of chemicals or anything like that," Zuckerberg said.
He joked about having coffee occasionally while on vacation, describing it as more of a rare "celebration" than part of his daily routine.
So what does Zuckerberg do instead?
"I wake up and I fight people," he joked.

Zuckerberg said he typically wakes up around 7 or 7:30 a.m., often when his children start making noise. After checking his phone and seeing the various issues he needs to deal with, he said he composes himself and heads into training.
"I compose myself and go fight for two hours," Zuckerberg said, describing the routine as a way to "reenter" himself before tackling work.
The billionaire has trained in

params.linkText: Brazilian jiu-jitsu and mixed martial arts

children: and said he has recently been doing more striking.
Why Zuckerberg Calls Jiu-Jitsu ‘the Greatest Sport’
Zuckerberg said combat sports provide more than just a physical workout, calling jiu-jitsu "the greatest sport."
"It’s neurologically stimulating," he said, while also pointing to its cardio and strength benefits.

He also likes the learning process involved in jiu-jitsu. Zuckerberg agreed with Von’s observation that in jiu-jitsu, even when you are on the losing side, you can walk away having learned something — allowing you to "lose and win at the same time."
Mark Zuckerberg’s $212 Billion Net Worth
Zuckerberg currently has a net worth of $212 billion, according to Forbes. Under his leadership, Meta currently has a market cap of $1.57 trillion.
